day_local: Isikhumbuzo sikaSaint Andrew Dung-Lac, uMbingeleli, kunye namaQabane akhe, amaNgqina okholo
greeting: Egameni likaYise, neloNyana, neloMoya oyiNgcwele. Amen. Makube noxolo lweNkosi yethu uYesu Kristu kubo bonke abakhoyo namhlanje.
penitential: Nkosi, usivele imfesane. Kristu, usivele imfesane. Nkosi, usivele imfesane.
homily:
Khumbula umzuzu apho ubona umntwana oselula ejonge phezulu esibhakabhakeni, amehlo akhe ekhazimla njengoko ebona inqwelo-moya iqhawula amafu. KuBenjamin Vo, loo mzuzu wawungengomdlalo nje; wawungumzamo wokubona ngaphaya kwemida yeli hlabathi, ukufikelela kwizinto ezinkulu, ezintsha, nezikhanyayo. UBen wayengumfana owayehlala ejonge phambili, owayenengqondo eqaqambileyo eyayikwazi ukuqonda imfihlelo yezinto ezinzima, kodwa intliziyo yakhe yayisala isengumntwana ongenakhethileyo, ogcwele uthando olumsulwa. Namhlanje, kwiNcwadi yeSityhilelo, uYohane usibonisa umbono onamandla: 'Iyeza ixesha lokuvuna, kuba isivuno somhlaba sivuthiwe.' Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… Isivuno sivuthiwe. Kwiingqondo zethu, sicinga ngesivuno njengento elungileyo, kodwa xa sijongene nokulahleka komntwana, loo mazwi anokuvakala ebuhlungu. Kodwa uThixo akavuni nje ngenxa yokuthatha; uvuna ngenxa yokuba uthando lwakhe lufuna ukugcina okuxabisekileyo kwindawo apho kungekho ntlungu, kungekho zifo, kwaye kungekho mda.

KwiVangeli yanamhlanje, abafundi babonisa uYesu ubuhle betempile, amatye ayo abizayo, kunye nezinto ezaziyihombisile. Babecinga ukuba oku kuhlala ngonaphakade. Kodwa uYesu, ngelizwi elithobekileyo kodwa elinzulu, uthi: 'Yonke le nto niyibonayo… kuya kufika imihla apho kungeyi kushiyeka litye phezu kwelinye.' Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… Akuyi kushiyeka litye phezu kwelinye. UYesu akayi kusoyikisa; Uyasikhumbuza inyani yobomi. Yonke into esiyakhela yona apha, yonke imigudu yethu, idlula. Kodwa oko akusithethi ukuba ubomi abunantsingiselo. Kanti, kuthetha ukuba intsingiselo ayikho kumatye, kodwa ikuThixo ophilayo. UBen wayeyiqonda le nto ngendlela yakhe. Wayengumfana owayethanda ukwakha, owayenohlelo lwakhe lwe-GitHub, owayecinga nge-'con chim airlines' yakhe, kodwa wayesazi ukuba ubomi bakhe babungekho kwizinto azakhayo, babusezandleni zikaThixo.

Alan noThao, ndiyazi ukuba kule minyane mihlanu idlulileyo ukususela ngowe-13 kuJuni 2026, intliziyo yenu ikhumbula loo mzuzu xa uBen wayesemncumile, ehleka, kwaye esenza amaphupha akhe abe yinyani. Ndiyazi ukuba kukho amaxesha apho nibuzayo ukuba kutheni, kwaye kutheni ngoku. Kodwa namhlanje, ndifuna ukususa elo litye lokuzisola ezintliziyweni zenu. UBen akazange agule ngenxa yokuba kukho into eniyenzileyo okanye eningayenzanga. Akukho nto niyiphosileyo. Iziphithiphithi zeli hlabathi, izifo, kunye neentlungu, zizinto ezenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lwethu. UThixo akakubeki icala, kwaye uBen akakubeki icala. UBen wayenothando olungagungqiyo kuni, kwaye uthando lwakhe lusaqhubeka lukhanya. Niyikhumbula loo ndlela wayefuna ngayo ukunika yonke imali yakhe yasebhange ukuze ancede umalume wakhe uWilliam? Wayengazange ayiphule loo ngulube, kodwa isipho sasingaphakathi entliziyweni yakhe. Le yimfihlelo yobomi: asikokuba unika malini, kodwa ukuba intliziyo yakho ikulungele na ukunika. UBen wayeyiqonda le nto. Wayengumfana owayethanda ukwabelana, owayethanda ukuhleka, owayethanda ukuba noRyan ecaleni kwakhe. Uthando lwakhe lwalungapheliyo, kwaye lusaqhubeka lukhanya nangoku.

Ryan, mfowethu okhoyo apha, ndifuna uthathe oku nawe. UBen akakushiye. Ukhona ecaleni kwakho, eqhubeka ekusebenza njengesikhokelo sothando. UBen wayengumfana owayenenqgondo enkulu yezibalo nolwazi, kodwa ikratshi lakhe elikhulu kwakuwukuba ngumntwana omhle owayehlonipha abazali bakhe. UBen uya kuhlala ekukhuthaza, nangona ungamboni ngamehlo, kodwa uya kumva entliziyweni yakho. Uthando lwenu njengabazalwana luyinto engunaphakade. Xa uziva usodwa, khumbula ukuba uBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. UBen akakho nje kwimbali yenu; ukwikhona apho uThixo enza khona yonke into ibe ntsha. UBen ngoku ungumntu okhululekileyo, ophilileyo, ojonge phezulu kuThixo ngoncumo olufanayo nolokuba wayesemncinci.

Masithathe oku namhlanje: uBen wasishiya isipho sothando olungapheliyo. Kwisikhumbuzo sesidlo sasezulwini, lapho indlu kaThixo izele khona ngabantu abavela kude nakufi, masime nathi namhlanje siqinisekile ukuba ubomi bukaBen abuphelanga ethuneni. Usemthekweni wasezulwini, apho i-'con chim airlines' yakhe ibhabha ngokuphakamileyo phambi kobuso bukaThixo. Hamba ke namhlanje uphumle, uthembe ukuba uThixo uyakuthanda, kwaye uBen ulinda wena ngoncumo lwakhe oluqhelekileyo. Uthando lwakho, Ben, lusaqhubeka luhamba emhlabeni, lusaqhubeka lukhanya, kwaye lusaqhubeka lukhumbuza wonke umntu okwaziyo ukuba uThixo uyamthanda umntwana wakhe ngaphezu kwayo yonke into. Hlalani neli themba. Hlalani nolu thando. UBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. Amen.
spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam uYesu, ndiyakholwa ukuba ukhona kwiSakramente eliNgcwele. Ndiyakuthanda ngaphezu kwayo yonke into, kwaye ndinqwenela ukukwamkela emphefumlweni wam. Ekubeni ndingenakukwamkela ngoku ngokwasemzimbeni, nceda uze kum ngokomoya entliziyweni yam. Ndiyakwamkela njengokuba sele ukhona, kwaye ndizimanya nawe ngokupheleleyo. Ungaze undivumele ndahlukane nawe. Amen.
closing: INkosi mayisisikelele, isigcine ebubini, ize isikhokelele kubomi obungunaphakade. Amen.
standing_petitions: Sithandazela uBen nabo bonke abasishiyileyo, ukuze baphumle elukhanyeni lukaKristu.
Sithandazela bonke abalilayo, ukuze uThixo abathuthuzele abanike ithemba.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text: Mna, Yohane, ndajonga, ndabona ilifu elimhlophe, phezu kwelifu kuhlala onjengonyana womntu, enesithsaba segolide entloko, nesikere esibukhali esandleni sakhe. Kwaphuma esinye isithunywa etempileni, sikhala ngezwi elikhulu kulo uwayehleli efini, sisithi: 'Sebenzisa isikere sakho uvune, kuba ixesha lokuvuna lifikile, kuba isivuno somhlaba sivuthiwe.' Lowo wayehleli efini wayijikela isikere sakhe emhlabeni, waza umhlaba wavunwa. Kwaphuma esinye isithunywa etempileni esezulwini, naso sinaso isikere esibukhali. Kwaphuma esinye isithunywa esivela esibingelelweni, esasinamandla phezu komlilo, sakhala ngezwi elikhulu kweso sasinesikere esibukhali, sisithi: 'Sebenzisa isikere sakho esibukhali, uqumbe izithebe zomdiliya womhlaba, kuba iidiliya zawo zivuthiwe.' Isithunywa sayijikela isikere sakhe emhlabeni, saqumba isivuno somhlaba, saza siphosa kwisixovulelo esikhulu somsindo kaThixo.

readings.label: INdumiso
readings.text: R. INkosi iyeza ukugweba ihlabathi. Yithini phakathi kweentlanga: INkosi ingukumkani. Ilizwe limi laziwa, aliyi kushukuma; iyawugweba imizi ngobulungisa. R. INkosi iyeza ukugweba ihlabathi. Mazivuye izulu, umhlaba mawugcobe; maludume ulwandle nako konke okuzalisileyo; imihlaba mayivuye nako konke okukuyo! Ziya kuvuya ke zonke imithi yehlathi. R. INkosi iyeza ukugweba ihlabathi. Phambi kweNkosi, kuba iyeza; kuba iyeza ukulawula ihlabathi. Iya kulawula ihlabathi ngobulungisa, iintlanga ngokunyaniseka kwayo. R. INkosi iyeza ukugweba ihlabathi.

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: Ngethuba abanye bethetha ngendlela itempile eyayihlotshiswe ngamatye abizayo nezipho, uYesu wathi: 'Konke enikubonayo apha—kuya kufika imihla apho kungeyi kushiyeka litye phezu kwelinye elingayi kuwiselwa phantsi.' Bambuza besithi: 'Mfundisi, oku kuya kwenzeka nini? Kwaye luphi uphawu xa ezi zinto ziza kwenzeka?' Waphendula wathi: 'Lumkani ningalahlekiswa, kuba baninzi abaya kuza egameni lam, besithi: 'Ndinguye,' nethi: 'Ixesha lifikile.' Ningabalandeli! Xa nisiva ngeemfazwe neziyaluyalu, ningoyiki; kuba ezo zinto mazenzeke kuqala, kodwa isiphelo asiyi kufika ngoko nangoko.' Wathi kubo: 'Isizwe siya kuvukela isizwe, nobukumkani buvukele ubukumkani. Kuya kubakho iinyikima ezinkulu, indlala, nezibetho kwindawo ngendawo; kwaye kuya kubakho izinto ezoyikekayo nemiqondiso emikhulu evela ezulwini.'

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: I miss you so much Ben! Ba má nhớ con rất nhiều mỗi ngày.
Nha Trang, ngày 31/10/2026, anh Minh suy nghĩ về Ben rất nhiều. Nhớ và thương em!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - mom and I have been missing you a lot.   Saw you a few times in my dreams last few weeks! Come and say hi daily okay?
Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever
